## Checklist

- [ ] Built test-first (red → green → refactor)
- [ ] `make check` is green (coverage ≥70% on touched packages)

- [ ] `.claude/rules/PRIVACY_SECURITY.md` respected (no raw transcript logging, `textContent` only)
